protocol: Follow the exact pip-next command with each case's arguments. This is a frozen tool/source environment, not live project status. Common evidence plus the case evidence is the complete available input; do not inspect live project files or execute shell commands. Case evidence overrides common evidence with the same source. An unprovided response is UNKNOWN. Save each assessment and judge every required and forbidden conclusion; do not infer success from contract-text checks. Omit actual handoff/source-command writes during simulation and say they are simulated. Expected conclusions are the oracle, not extra project evidence.
